title: NIA turns over 3 solar-powered irrigation projects in Leyte, Samar

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Three solar-powered irrigation projects in Leyte and Samar were turned over to local farmers early this week, providing a more reliable water supply for 42 hectares of farmland as Eastern Visayas faces agricultural challenges from climate change and El Niño. The National Irrigation Administration (NIA) Region 8 said the projects are located in the villages of Catougan and San Isidro in Sta. Fe, Leyte, and Cabacungan in Calbayog City, Samar. The turnover ceremonies were led by NIA-8 Regional Manager Jaime de Jesus as the agency expands its irrigation services to help farmers sustain agricultural production and strengthen their […]...
